requiresEveryCondition: at least one distinct crop cluster improves
at least one distinct Brand design improves
all source and model hashes verify
no concealed confidence or abstention assumption

NO_EVIDENCE_OF_GAIN.when: no crop-cluster improvement, or no design improvement, without a material design regression

whenAnyOf: a comparison that cannot be interpreted without changing the frozen design

severeRepeatedUnsupportedOutput.definition: True only when primary PP-OCRv6 outputs are classified NOT_VISUALLY_SUPPORTED in at least two distinct crop clusters spanning at least two distinct Brand designs. Otherwise false.
countingRules: The primary and the repeat of one item count once.
The byte-identical C1 crop counts once.
Multiple OCR items in one crop cluster count once.
Multiple items in one Brand design count once.
severeRepeatedUnsupportedOutput.evidenceRequirement: NOT_VISUALLY_SUPPORTED requires direct inspection of the frozen crop pixels. Where meaningful inspection is unavailable the item is UNADJUDICATED; visual support is never inferred from the transcript or from the truth string.
severeRepeatedUnsupportedOutput.scopeNote: Only primary outputs are classified. Repeats contribute nothing additional, because a deterministic repeat carries no independent visual evidence.
severeRepeatedUnsupportedOutput.strictnessNote: With four crop clusters and three Brand designs in the frozen population, and both thresholds set at two, a single unsupported item cannot trigger this condition, and neither can several unsupported items confined to one Brand design.
severeRepeatedUnsupportedOutput.amendedBy: preregistration-amendment.md, before model retrieval and before any inference

designRegressionRule: Any material regression within a repeated Brand design makes that design a regression. An improvement within the same design does not cancel it.
cropClusterRule: The duplicate C1 crop counts once.
aggregationRule: No averaging may conceal an item-level material regression.
keepAuthorizes: a separately planned expanded held-out benchmark
keepDoesNotAuthorize: production Python or ONNX Runtime dependencies

priorConclusionsPreserved.pr214: REGRESSION for PARSeq-small versus incumbent Tesseract. Unchanged and not reinterpreted by this experiment.
priorConclusionsPreserved.pr215: COMPATIBLE for the PP-OCRv6-small ONNX compatibility probe. Unchanged and not reinterpreted by this experiment.
